Rob Mounsey has led a robust career as a keyboardist, session musician, arranger, and composer. He has collaborated with a lengthy list of the finest musicians in the business.
Rob was interviewed via Zoom on April 9, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
